gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 400 W kit costs $913.49 through our link today, which is $0.48 per Wh, ships now, and needs 4.8 hours of rated sun to refill from its own panel (1,920 Wh / 400 W). The kit ChatGPT ranked first, the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2× 200 W, works out to $0.69 per Wh and 5.2 hours, and it is a pre-order that dispatches Nov 26, 2026.
standout_why: StormWatts (Nov 8) already computes kit $/kWh, implied panel $/W and refill share on a 4.5-sun-hour day, but only at store prices and only for BLUETTI, EcoFlow, Jackery and Anker. It has the Elite 200 V2 + 2× 200 W at $723/kWh and no ALLPOWERS kit at all. Eco Solar Kits (Nov 7/9) gives $/kWh mostly for bare stations; its only kits are two Jackery bundles it lists as sold out, and its refill days are for generic panel sizes, not each kit's own panels. Neither page prices kits at a code price, and neither puts $/Wh, refill hours and shipping state side by side. OutageReady and our own two pages failed with a certificate error, so I could not compare against them.
decides: The page rule says the pick must ship now. Among ~2 kWh kits with at least 2,000 W AC and 400 W of panels, the R2500 V2 + SP037 is the cheapest per Wh and refills about as fast as the BLUETTI, so it is the ship-now pick. The Elite 200 V2 + 2× 200 W becomes the option for a shopper who can wait until Nov 26 and wants 2,600 W AC and 1,000 W of solar input. Jackery's 200 W panel is a pre-order shipping by Nov 28, so its kit does not ship now either. I could not read the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max kit's panel count or shipping state (HTTP 429).
